named_probes: Probe 1: icacls every deployed path and classify writers into owner / administrators / SYSTEM / broad groups.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): empirically attempt a write to a sample of those paths from a non-elevated context and record success, since inherited-deny interactions make the textual ACL hard to read correctly.
note: Thin pointer (no unit_id/artifacts) so unit_manifest discovery will not double-count it.
